```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
data(nyc_airbnb)
```

# Some questions
* where are the most expensive airbnbs in nyc?
* do description correlate with price?
* what about text reviews?


```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group =="Manhattan") |>
  count(room_type, neighbourhood) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
```

# price
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |>
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(price))) |>
  filter(price < 3)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(price < 1000) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=price)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(room_type ~ neighbourhood)
```
## Host stuff
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  ggplot(aes (x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
